risk_description:
Improper rings used for rocker panel protectors can cause them to come loose and fall on the road, posing a risk to traffic.
Contact may occur between the vacuum hose and the surrounding parts. This may result in loss of the braking assistance, increasing the risk of an accident.
The bonnet locking screws are insufficiently tightened. As a result, the bonnet could become detached while driving, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
